chunks: Safwan, from Ibn Muskan, from Layth al-Muradi and 'Abd al-A'la ibn A'yan, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
The diyah of the Jew and the Christian is eight hundred dirhams.

key_terms.النَّصْرَانِيِّ: a Christian person, in the legal context of this ruling
key_terms.الْيَهُودِيِّ: a Jewish person, in the legal context of this ruling
key_terms.دِرْهَمٍ: dirhams, a unit of monetary value
key_terms.دِيَةُ: financial compensation prescribed for unlawful killing or injury

ai.seo_question: What is the diyah of a Jew or a Christian in this hadith from Tahdhib al-Ahkam?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the diyah for a Jewish or Christian person. It belongs to the jurisprudential discussions of retaliatory law and compensation between different legal categories of persons.
